_note: Fill in `inputs` using the unit in each _guide entry. Help text may quote SI units; the `unit` field is the one that applies. psig and psia are different: gauge arguments (set_g, back_g ...) are psig, absolute ones psia. Temperatures are readings, not differences.

text.help: text to search in title, publisher, note and topics

region.help: e.g. US, UK, EU, IN, SG, AU, ME, global

kind.help: regulation, standard, guidance, investigation, database, association, journal, news, data-tool

read_only.help: only sources whose content was read for the toolkit

markdown.help: print the whole index as Markdown (docs/LITERATURE.md)
